\caption{\bt{\system\ architecture: a definition learned once from a verified session is shared by every user agent (here $m_1^3$, learned from the learning agent, an LLM agent; any user agent's verified session teaches the memory the same way). Learning path (1--3): the answer record of a verified session becomes a candidate, published after the publication checks. Use path (4--7): a lookup compares versions and returns the valid revision $m^r$; maintenance reuses check results, runs only missing checks, and repairs a failed definition only with a unique filter that passes the regression test. Execution path (8--9): a query declaring $m^r$ is checked against its conditions and run on one snapshot. Here only $T_2$ was written, so $c_3$ lacks a current result and $m_2^1$ is pending.}{\system\ 架构：从一次核对正确的会话中只学一次的定义由所有用户端智能体共享（此处为 $m_1^3$，学自学习智能体，即一个大模型智能体；任何用户端智能体核对正确的会话都以同样方式教给记忆）。学习路径（1--3）：核对正确的会话的答案记录成为候选，经发布前检查后发布。使用路径（4--7）：查找比较版本并返回有效版本 $m^r$；维护复用检查结果，只执行缺失的检查，并只用通过回归测试的唯一过滤修复失效定义。执行路径（8--9）：声明 $m^r$ 的查询在同一快照上核对其条件并执行。示例中只有 $T_2$ 被写入，因此 $c_3$ 缺少当前版本的结果，$m_2^1$ 处于待验证状态。}}
\label{fig:architecture}
\Description{On the top left, inside MAVRA's area, sit the built-in learning agent, an LLM agent drawn like the user agents but in MAVRA's blue with an LLM mark, and an LLM extractor. User agents, drawn as people asking questions, stay outside MAVRA on the top right; each holds the same shared definition $m_1^3$, which the store marks as learned. In the MAVRA middleware, the publication checks on the left publish into a central shared store of definitions and check results; condition maintenance and automatic repair with the regression test sit below the store and write back into it; lookup and same-snapshot validation on the right read from the store, and the revision returned by the lookup is the one the query declares. A version tracker feeds table versions $V(T)$ to the lookup. A database at the bottom holds tables, whose rows changed by ETL writers raise their versions, the versions themselves, and the snapshot $D_s$ on which same-snapshot validation checks every condition of $m^r$ and runs the query. Step numbers 1--9 and arrows are colored by learning, use, and execution path; thick arrows write the shared store and dashed arrows read database state.}
\end{figure*}
